adoptedPrinciples: Explain the product and the designer’s actual contribution before the detailed walkthrough.
Use everyday task language for section headings and describe why a specific decision helps.
Keep screenshots close to the decision they explain, with complete frames available.
Separate design delivery from measured product outcomes; preserve team credit and genuine uncertainties.
notCopied: No reference prose, research, client facts, metrics, timelines, imagery, branding or claimed outcomes transplanted into this portfolio. The approved website shell is preserved.
